_meta.scope: China housing-loan rules for game '14亿分之1'; rules in force as of 2026-10-16
_meta.notes: Every value carries source+url. confidence: high = official text/official stats read directly; medium = reputable media report of official notice read directly; low = search-snippet only or derived; memory/unverified flagged explicitly. Amounts in CNY; 万 = 10,000.

legal_basis.regulation: 住房公积金管理条例 as amended by 国务院令第844号 (signed 2026-08-10, approved at State Council executive meeting 2026-07-31)
key_changes: Withdrawal scenarios expanded from 6 to 9: rent; buy/build/rebuild/major repair of own home; repay home-loan principal+interest; renovation of own home (NEW); property-management fees of own home (NEW); retirement; total loss of work capacity + end of employment; emigration; other housing consumption approved by State Council (NEW)
Renting: the old condition that rent must exceed a set share of household wage income was removed – paying rent is sufficient
Withdrawal decision within 3 days of acceptance; loan decision within 10 days (was 15)
Flexible workers (个体工商户, 非全日制, 其他灵活就业) may contribute voluntarily; prefecture-level cities set rules
Contribution: employer and employee each >= 5% of employee's prior-year average monthly wage, not above national maximum; local committee drafts, provincial govt approves
Fraudulent withdrawal: repay + 3-year ban on withdrawals/loans; fraudulent loan: repay + 5-year ban; credit records shared on national credit platform
Funds may buy national bonds and policy-bank financial bonds; nationwide mutual recognition of contribution records / cross-region loans
legal_basis.source: 国务院关于修改《住房公积金管理条例》的决定（国务院令第844号）, reprinted on 生态环境部 site

contributors_2024.source: 全国住房公积金2024年年度报告 (住房城乡建设部、财政部、中国人民银行), full PDF text

contributors_2023.source: 全国住房公积金2023年年度报告 as cited in search results (net increase 174.07万 in 2024 confirmed in 2024 report)

contributors_2025.note: 全国住房公积金2025年年度报告 not found online as of 2026-10-16 (city/provincial 2025 reports published Mar–May 2026, e.g. 深圳 729.37万 contributors, 北京 932.45万). See gaps.

urban_employment_2024.display: 年末城镇就业人员 47345万人 (全国就业人员 73439万人; 农民工 29973万人)
urban_employment_2024.source: 国家统计局 2024年国民经济和社会发展统计公报

by_employer_type_2024.note: 2024 report only splits 企业/非企业/灵活就业; it no longer splits 国有 vs 私营. 2023 report (cited in search results): 城镇私营企业等 = 53.47% of contributors and 75.55% of new accounts.
by_employer_type_2024.source: 全国住房公积金2024年年度报告 表2

flexible_workers.value: 试点城市 expanded 13 -> 36 in 2024; >100万 flexible workers had contributed by end-2024, of whom 24万 used funds to rent/buy. Voluntary flexible-worker contribution became national law from 2026-09-20 (条例 Art.49).
flexible_workers.source: 全国住房公积金2024年年度报告; 国务院令第844号

migrant_workers.note: No current official figure found. NBS 农民工监测调查 stopped publishing 五险一金 coverage after ~2014 (then roughly 5-6% for HPF).

other_2024_system_stats.source: 全国住房公积金2024年年度报告

rate_range.value: employer 5%–12%, employee 5%–12% (usually same rate both sides). 2026 条例 sets floor 5% of prior-year avg monthly wage and 'not above national maximum' (12% per 2005 三部门指导意见).
rate_range.source: 国务院令第844号 Art.18; Beijing 2025 notice (5%–12%)

hardship_reduction.value: Beijing: firms in difficulty may apply to cut to 1%–4% or defer (缓缴) for the policy year
hardship_reduction.source: 北京日报 on 北京2025住房公积金年度缴存基数 notice

shanghai_rate_set.value: 上海 basic HPF: whole-number rates 5%, 6% or 7% only (employer=employee); 补充公积金 separate 1%–5%
shanghai_rate_set.source: Kaizen CPA summary of Shanghai 2026 base rules (third-party; supplementary 1–5% from memory)
shanghai_rate_set.url: https://www.kaizencpa.com/download/china/2026 Shanghai New Social Security & HPF Base Rules(CHS).pdf

typical_in_practice.value: 机关事业单位 and large SOEs commonly 12%; most private firms 5% (some 7%–10%); many small private firms do not contribute at all
typical_in_practice.note: No national distribution of actual rates is published. Treat as game assumption.

base_cap.rule: monthly base cap = 3 x local prior-year average monthly wage (城镇单位/全口径); floor = local minimum wage

北京_2026年度.note: not yet published when 雄安 notice issued (Jul 2026)

上海_2026年度.note: Until 2026 cap announced, 2025 cap 37302 applies; third-party reports 37731 (=3x12577)

deposit_rate.rule: Account balances earn the PBOC 1-year time-deposit benchmark rate (1.50%) since 2016-02-21 (银发〔2016〕43号), regardless of current/fixed portions. Interest is settled annually on June 30 and capitalised.
deposit_rate.still_applied: Beijing and Guangzhou 2024–2025 and 2025–2026 interest settlements at 1.5%; July 2026 reports still state 1.5%
deposit_rate.cross_check: 2024 national 支付缴存人利息 1597.29亿 / avg balance ≈105,000亿 ≈ 1.52%
deposit_rate.source: search results citing 北京公积金中心 doc and 2026-07 reports; 全国2024年报 for cross-check

national_2024.source: 全国住房公积金2024年年度报告

北京.value: No invoice: 2000元/人/月 (raised from 1500); with invoice for commercial rental: actual rent up to own monthly contribution; public/affordable rental: actual rent; 多子女 families: actual rent (not capped by contribution); monthly frequency
北京.source: 界面新闻 on 北京公积金中心 rental-withdrawal optimisation

上海.value: Market rental: 4000元/户/月 (raised from 3000), monthly (was quarterly); 保障性租赁住房: actual rent
上海.source: 新京报 via search result on 上海公积金管委会《关于优化本市住房公积金租赁提取业务相关事项的通知》

西安(陕西省直).value: 24000元/年 standard; 多子女 and new citizens/youth ≤35: 28800元/年

南宁.value: 1200元/人/月 (from 1000); +200 for 二孩, +400 for 三孩

down_payment_use.value: National policy (2024) encourages using HPF to pay the down payment. 上海 from 2025-08-26: buyer+spouse may withdraw balance for down payment on new presale homes, paid directly into developer's escrow account, does not reduce loan cap. 西安 2026-09: withdrawal for down payment on second-hand homes via escrow.
down_payment_use.source: 全国2024年报 (支持缴存人提取住房公积金支付购房首付款); 财联社 on 沪公积金管委会〔2025〕4号

repayment_withdrawal.value: 还贷提取: allowed by 条例 (repay principal+interest); typically monthly/annual entrusted offset (委托提取/按月冲还贷). Both own-city HPF loans and commercial mortgages qualify. Beijing Aug 2026: renovation withdrawal ≤50% of invoice and ≤25万, once per 10 years; Hangzhou Apr 2026: property fee withdrawal ≤1万/户/年.
repayment_withdrawal.source: 国务院令第844号; 光明网 on 北京2026-08 policy; 杭州网 on 杭州 2026-04 policy

continuous_contribution.value: Typically ≥6 consecutive months of normal (足额) contribution at application (北京: 连续缴存半年以上且账户正常缴存). Some cities require 12 months. 广州 2026 draft: 缴存满半年.
continuous_contribution.source: 北京本地宝 Q&A on 北京公积金中心 rules; 金羊网 headline on 广州 draft

other.value: No outstanding HPF loan for borrower+spouse (some cities 2026 temporarily lift 'loan count' limits: 成都 2026-03-25 to 2026-12-31, 杭州 2026, 北京 2026-08 allows new loan after full repayment); local purchase eligibility; monthly repayment ≤ 50% household income (广州) or 40% repayment ratio in formula (武汉)

processing_time.value: Loan decision within 10 days of acceptance (from 2026-09-20)

current.note: PBOC cut by 0.25pp (notice 2025-05-07). Verified 2.6% for first home >5y. Second-home rates are 'not lower than' 1.1x first-home rate.
current.source: 中国新闻网 (citing PBOC notice and Beijing center)

existing_loans.value: Loans >1 year issued before 2025-05-08 keep old rate for 2025 and switch to new rate on 2026-01-01 (annual Jan-1 repricing). Loans ≤1 year keep contract rate.

local_subsidy_example.value: 成都: until 2026-12-31, HPF center subsidises 20% of monthly interest, ≤2.5万 per loan

北京.other_bonus: +20万 城六区户籍 buying first home outside 城六区; +40万 green building; stacking max +60万 (one contributor) / +100万 (two) → max 340万
北京.balance_multiple: Not balance-based: 20万 per year of contribution (one contributor); 40万 per year for couple (longer spouse's years); part-years count as full years; also limited by repayment capacity
北京.source: 光明网 on 北京八部门 notice

上海.other_bonus: +15% two-star+ new green building; stacking +35% → first home family 324万, second home 270万
上海.balance_multiple: not stated in sources (Shanghai uses account balance multiple, historically 30x – memory/unverified)
上海.previous: 2025-08-26: first-home family 160万 (green 184万; multi-child 192万→216万); second-home family 130万

深圳.multi_child_bonus: +70% for 2+ children (or +50% 初婚初育; choose one)
深圳.other_bonus: +60% first home in Shenzhen; +40% 保障性住房; uplifts add up (media: max 189万 single / 351万 family)
深圳.source: 深圳市人民政府 site (official notice)

广州.multi_child_bonus: 育儿 (child under 18): 1 child +10%, 2 children +40%, 3+ children +50%
广州.other_bonus: 1-star green/prefab +10%, 2-star+ green +20%, '好房子' +30% (take highest of building-type uplifts); stack with child uplift up to +80% → 180万 single / 360万 two+
广州.balance_multiple: 账户余额 x 8 + 月缴存额 x 至退休月数 (formula published 2025-02; not confirmed changed in 2026); monthly repayment ≤50% of income
广州.source: 广州市人民政府 site, 《广州住房公积金管理中心关于调整住房公积金贷款政策的通知》; formula from gz.gov.cn 2025-02-18

杭州.other_bonus: new citizens/youth +20%; green low-carbon +20%; trade-in +20%; stackable up to +70% → family max 306万
杭州.balance_multiple: 月均账户余额 x 20 (raised from 15), capped by individual max
杭州.note: 桐庐/淳安/建德: single 65万, family 130万

成都.other_bonus: +20% for ready-built (现房) or demolition-resettlement purchases → 96万/144万; +20% one-star+ green new homes (from 2025-08-25, not stackable)
成都.note: Loan-count limit lifted 2026-03-25 to 2026-12-31; temporary 15% min down payment and 20% interest subsidy until 2026-12-31 (snippet)

郑州.multi_child_bonus: +20% → 144万 (郑州市中心); 河南省直 from 2026-10-10: ordinary family 130万, multi-child 156万, talent 180万
郑州.effective: 郑州市中心 cap: date unconfirmed (cites 郑公积金〔2023〕53号); 省直: 2026-10-10
郑州.note: Cap is per family; single vs dual contributors not distinguished. 2026-08-26: existing-home min down payment 30%→20%.
郑州.source: 东方财富 (省直, 2026-10-10); search snippet for city center

武汉.multi_child_bonus: multi-child purchase support (套数核减) extended to 2026-12-31; no cap uplift found
武汉.balance_multiple: Repayment-capacity formula with 还贷比例 40% (raised from 35%)
武汉.note: Same cap for first and second home. 2026-04-02: existing-home LTV first ≤80%, second ≤70%; hukou limit removed for non-local contributors.

西安.effective: 2026-09-07 (陕西省住房资金管理中心 notice implementing 西安 measures; 西安 city center reported 120万 couple 2026-08-26)

济南.multi_child_bonus: +40% for multi-child / talent buying high-quality or ready homes, stackable, max 240万
济南.source: 腾讯新闻 AI-assisted local digest (low reliability)

贵阳.multi_child_bonus: multi-child first home 60万 single / 80万 couple
贵阳.effective: 2024-04 phased policy (to 2024-12-31); reportedly extended to end-2026 with higher caps (headline '最高贷150万' unverified)
贵阳.source: search snippet on 贵阳公积金中心 2024 notice

兰州.note: current caps not found; 2026-04-07 rent withdrawal raised to 2万/人/年

南宁.multi_child_bonus: first home: +10万 (2 children), +20万 (3 children); +10万 for new commercial housing; stackable → max 120万
南宁.note: Caps are per loan/household, single vs dual not distinguished in source. May be suspended if fund utilisation >85%.
南宁.effective: 2026-08-01 (南宁住房公积金管委会, issued 2026-07-29)

typical_prefecture.evidence: Guangdong prefecture cities, 2026: 惠州 50万/90万 (multi-child +20%, max 108万); 江门 40万/80万; 肇庆 50万/80万 (+15万 multi-child); 清远 50万/70万; 阳江 50万/75万
typical_prefecture.source: 楚天都市报 citing 央视新闻 2026-03-26

national_rule.note: 2015-03-30: first home min 20%; 2015-09-01: second home (first loan repaid) 30%→20%; 北上广深 may set their own (historically 30% for second). Cities may go lower: 广州 20% first/second, 15% 保障房; 成都 temporary 15% until 2026-12-31; 郑州 existing homes 20% (from 2026-08-26); 武汉 existing homes max LTV 80%/70%.

term.age_rule: Maturity ≤ statutory retirement age + 5 years, generally ≤68 (men) / ≤63 (women) after the 2025 retirement-age reform (北京 from 2025-01-01: cap raised 65→68; 重庆、哈尔滨 2025-01-01; 西安 2025-01-22, 昆明 2025-03-24, 青岛 2025-03)
term.example: 北京: applicant 40, spouse 45 → max term 28 years (68-40, longer of the two)
term.note: The 2026 commercial-loan rule (40-year max) does not change HPF 30-year cap as far as found.

loan_stats_2024.source: 全国住房公积金2024年年度报告 表5 (avg derived)

down_payment.rule: Since 2024-09-29 (notice dated 2024-09-27) commercial mortgages no longer distinguish first/second home; nationwide floor 15%. Provincial PBOC branches/NFRA offices may set higher local floors (e.g. 北上深 second homes higher). Previously (2024-05-17): first 15%, second 25%.
down_payment.changes_2025_2026: No change to residential floor found. 2026-01 (银发〔2026〕14号): commercial-use property (商业用房/商住两用) floor cut to 30% (was typically 50%). 个人住房贷款管理办法(试行) 2026-08-28 Art.8: min down payment = PBOC/NFRA floor, lenders may set higher.
down_payment.source: 新华网 2024-09-24 (潘功胜); search results on 银发〔2026〕14号; 新京报 on 管理办法

lpr_5y_history.note: latest fixing; unchanged 16 months. Only 5Y change points listed (1Y-only moves 2019-09, 2021-12, 2023-08 omitted). Next fixing 2026-10-20.

lpr_source.source: 全国银行间同业拆借中心 (chinamoney) LPR history API, queried 2026-10-16

avg_new_rate.note: weighted avg of repriced existing first-home loans, not new loans
record low at the time; down 0.12pp q/q
新发放个人住房贷款加权平均利率 (商业性 3.07%)

pricing_note.value: National first/second-home commercial rate floors abolished 2024-05; rates priced as LPR ± spread under provincial self-regulatory mechanisms. 上海 from 2025-08-26 no longer differentiates first/second home rates. Typical new first-home rate ≈ 3.0–3.1% (LPR-40 to -50bp).

repricing.rule: Floating-rate loans = 5Y LPR + fixed spread; rate resets once per repricing period, by default annually on 1 January or on the loan anniversary (borrower's choice at contract). Since 2024-11-01 borrowers may negotiate shorter repricing periods (minimum-one-year restriction removed) and negotiate the spread.

batch_cut_2023.value: Existing first-home loans repriced: 4973万笔, 21.7万亿元 adjusted in first week; avg cut 0.73pp to 4.27%

batch_cut_2024.value: All existing mortgages (first and second) with spread above LPR-30bp reset to LPR-30bp (≈3.30% at LPR 3.60%; ≈3.20% from 2025-06 resets at LPR 3.50%); avg cut ~0.5pp, ~5000万户/1.5亿人, saves ~1500亿元 interest per year. 北上深 second homes subject to local floors.

repricing.hpf_repricing: HPF loans reprice on 1 January following a rate change (e.g. 2025-05 cut applied to existing loans from 2026-01-01)
repricing.source: PBOC 公告〔2024〕第11号 as reported

limits.max_term_rule: 个人住房贷款管理办法(试行) Art.13: '最长不得超过40年' (was 30). Hardship extensions: cumulative ≤ half original term and total ≤ 40 years.
limits.effective: 2026-08-28 (金融监管总局+人民银行, effective on issuance; replaces 1998 rules)
limits.age_plus_term: Not set by regulation. Bank practice: big state banks age+term ≤75 (ICBC, some CCB branches); many city/joint-stock banks ≈68–70; borrower age 18–70. After 2026 rules some banks discussing 80, not confirmed (财联社 2026-09-04).
limits.dti: Monthly mortgage payment ≤ 50% of monthly (disposable) income incl. co-borrowers; all debt payments ≤ 60% (was 55% under 2004 指引).
limits.ltv_note: Loan ≤ lower of transaction price or appraisal less min down payment; collateral re-valued at least annually

combined_loan.value: 组合贷 = HPF loan up to the HPF cap/formula + a commercial mortgage from the entrusted bank for the shortfall; two contracts usually same term and same bank, each part at its own rate (HPF 2.6% / commercial LPR±spread), one down payment applies to the total. Combined total typically ≤ 80% of lower of appraisal/price. Variants: 商转公 (convert commercial to HPF, e.g. 广州 total ≤80% of value; 河南省直 introduced 商转公组合贷 2026-10).
combined_loan.source: 福建省住建厅 规范性文件 definition; 广州 商转公 report (search results)

prepayment.balance_source: PBOC 金融机构贷款投向统计报告 as reported (2026Q2 read directly on 中国金融信息网; others via search results citing PBOC)
prepayment.bank_evidence: ICBC: Jan–Feb 2023 mortgage prepayments 979亿元 (+220亿 y/y). Big-6 banks' mortgage books fell 5568.57亿 (2023), 6210.57亿 (2024), 7115.16亿 (2025). Some banks tightened online prepayment quotas in 2025; banks say prepayments not clearly declining in Sept 2026.
prepayment.drivers: Rate gap between old (≈4.9–5.9%) and new loans, low deposit/wealth-product yields; eased after 2023/2024 batch cuts

foreclosure.discount: Average 折价率 (deal price / appraised value) ≈ 74% (2025: 74.1%; Jan–Oct 2025: 74.4%). Starting price of 1st auction usually ≤70% of appraisal, 2nd auction a further ≤20% lower (judicial-auction rules – memory/unverified). Appraisal itself is often below market, so effective discount vs market ≈ 25–35% (game assumption).
foreclosure.source: 中指研究院 data via 新京报/每日经济新闻

commercial.note: No official national average for new commercial mortgages found. Game assumption: ~80–100万 tier-1/2, ~40–60万 lower-tier (memory/unverified).

gaps: 全国住房公积金2025年年度报告 not found (likely published mid-2026 but not located; mohurd.gov.cn unreachable). 2025 national contributor count therefore missing; 2024 figures used.
2025 年末城镇就业人员 not retrieved; coverage share uses 2024 (37.2%).
No official distribution of actual contribution rates (12% for 机关事业 vs 5% for private firms is an unverified assumption). No current HPF coverage for 农民工.
Shanghai rental-withdrawal 4000元/户/月 and Shanghai basic-rate set (5/6/7%) verified only via snippets/third-party.
City caps not found or outdated: 长沙, 石家庄, 兰州 (caps), 合肥 (2022 figures), 贵阳 (2024 figures); 济南 2026 figures from an AI-assisted digest; 郑州 city-center cap date unconfirmed.
Balance-multiple formulas only confirmed for 杭州 (20x), 广州 (8x balance + contribution x months to retirement), 北京 (20万/year of contribution), 兰州 (24x, 2023), 深圳 (16x, media). Others missing.
PBOC quarterly 新发放个人住房贷款加权平均利率 series incomplete; several points are 'about 3.1%' from press conferences.
HPF rate history before 2024 (2015, 2022 cuts) from memory.
No national commercial average new-mortgage size; no official 断供 (default) counts – foreclosure auctions used as proxy; commercial mortgage NPL ratio not collected.
Age+term rule for commercial loans is bank practice, not regulation; 2026 管理办法 sets no age limit.
Oct 2026 LPR (2026-10-20) not yet published as of compile date.
